Andoni Iraola loves a tactical foul. You can often spot him applauding from the touchline when one of his players takes the decision to halt an opposition attack before it develops into something dangerous. It is a key part of his football philosophy. Stop the transition early.

That mentality has clearly travelled with him to Liverpool. His side are averaging 13.75 fouls per game in the Premier League and I like the look of backing them to keep that average ticking over against Arsenal.

This fixture has all the ingredients for a high foul count. The intensity should be obvious from the first whistle, with both sides capable of hurting each other in transition and Arsenal happy to engage in a duel-heavy game. That's their bread and butter.

Marco Rose's side have now beaten Sturm Graz, Sunderland, AC Milan, Manchester United, Aston Villa and Leeds without conceding in an extraordinary run of results.
They were given a helping hand by Leeds goalkeeper James Trafford, whose Halloween horror show gifted Bournemouth the lead as Evanilson capitalised on a hapless pass out from the back.

items.title: In-demand Spain star Martin talks future plans: 'This is my home'
items.excerpt: "I have always said that this is my home." That is the response when talking to Jon Martin about life at Real Sociedad. He has been linked with Real Madrid, Barcelona and some of the biggest clubs in the Premier League. But any move will no…
body: "I have always said that this is my home." That is the response when talking to Jon Martin about life at Real Sociedad. He has been linked with Real Madrid, Barcelona and some of the biggest clubs in the Premier League. But any move will not happen just yet.

"I have been here since I was 12," Martin explains on the eve of the derby against Athletic Club. "At the end of the day, the feeling of belonging and of wanting to be here is something I feel from inside. So, as I said, I feel this is my home. It is where I want to be."

The 20-year-old centre-back is aware of the excitement about him. "I think that I am a player that people like," he says, rather modestly. He describes himself as grateful for the interest. In truth, it is an inevitable consequence of his performances for La Real. LaLiga: Table | Fixtures & results

Martin is a ball-playing defender with good technical ability and passing range. He made his debut for Spain in the summer and could be the long-term partner for Pau Cubarsi at the heart of the defence for the national team. A frightening prospect.

items.title: Arbeloa: We've made mistakes but Fulham on right path
items.excerpt: Having gone winless in your first six games and conceded goals at a rate of almost two a game, there are worse ways to recover than a pair of gritty 1-0 victories.
body: Having gone winless in your first six games and conceded goals at a rate of almost two a game, there are worse ways to recover than a pair of gritty 1-0 victories.

It is still early days in the Alvaro Arbeloa project at Fulham but the optimism a narrow but entertaining opening-weekend 3-2 defeat to Chelsea had brought from his debut in the dugout had quickly waned with such a poor run which had left them stranded bottom of the Premier League.

That openness which initially seemed a welcome tonic from the sometimes pragmatic Marco Silva era had quickly become the problem, with the Cottagers losing 3-2 again - this time to previously winless Crystal Palace - and shipping two late goals to Ipswich earlier this month to lose at Portman Road too.
